title: What If Prices Doubled Every Day? Zimbabwe Lived It

scenes.text: What if prices doubled every single day? In 2008, Zimbabwe found out.
In November 2008, prices there were doubling about every 24.7 hours.
The monthly inflation rate peaked at 79.6 billion percent, the second worst hyperinflation in history.
The government printed a 100 trillion dollar note. One account says a loaf of bread cost what 12 cars once did.
Shops emptied after the government set price ceilings below production costs, so supply dried up.
In the end, Zimbabwe gave up its own currency and replaced it with the US dollar.
